## `## Title` starts a slide {#slide}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="58%"}
```markdown
## Agenda

- Lorem ipsum
- Dolor sit amet
```
:::
::: {.column width="42%"}
**Agenda**

- Lorem ipsum
- Dolor sit amet
:::
::::

## Bullets one at a time {#incremental}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="58%"}
```markdown
::: {.incremental}
- Lorem ipsum
- Dolor sit amet
- Consectetur
:::
```
:::
::: {.column width="42%"}
::: {.incremental}
- Lorem ipsum
- Dolor sit amet
- Consectetur
:::
:::
::::

## A pause {#pause}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="58%"}
```markdown
Lorem ipsum.

. . .

Dolor sit amet.
```
:::
::: {.column width="42%"}
Lorem ipsum.

::: {.fragment}
Dolor sit amet.
:::
:::

## Highlight code lines, step by step {#code}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="58%"}
````markdown
```{.python
  code-line-numbers="1|2-3"}
def f(n):
    x = n + 1
    return x * 2
```
````
:::
::: {.column width="42%"}
```{.python code-line-numbers="1|2-3"}
def f(n):
    x = n + 1
    return x * 2
```

## Speaker notes and backgrounds {#notes}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="58%"}
```markdown
::: {.notes}
Only you see this: press s.
:::

## Hi {background-color="#e0f2fe"}
```
:::
::: {.column width="42%"}
Notes stay off the slide. `s` opens the speaker view, with the notes, the next
slide and a timer.

The next slide has a background.
:::
::::

::: {.notes}
Only you see this: press s.
:::

## Title {#background background-color="#e0f2fe"}

A slide with `{background-color="#e0f2fe"}`.
